response.sql: WITH awards AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank)') AS hand FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), grouped AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winners FROM awards GROUP BY hand) SELECT hand, winners, winners * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards) AS share FROM grouped ORDER BY winners DESC, hand;
